answer: Because the cipher ledger attributes every share, the crystal audit makes public the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it pays the trellis fee twice and still divides one payout. Only 55% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not forfeit. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
